fact.en: Assumption that Mauryan coins had kings' names: Mauryan PMCs are mostly symbol-based, not dynastic portraits.

fact.en: Confusing NBPW with earlier Painted Grey Ware (PGW); NBPW is the hallmark of the Mauryan urban revolution.
